overview: The two opposite arms of metabolism, one building complex molecules and the other breaking them down.
genZNote: Anabolism: construction crew, building things up. Catabolism: demolition crew, tearing things down for parts and energy.

aspects.label: Direction of Reactions
aspects.valueA: Builds larger, complex molecules from simpler ones.
aspects.valueB: Breaks down larger, complex molecules into simpler ones.

aspects.label: Example
aspects.valueA: Protein synthesis from amino acids; photosynthesis.
aspects.valueB: Cellular respiration breaking down glucose; digestion of food.

overlay.examHighYieldNote: Metabolism as a whole is the sum of all anabolic and catabolic reactions happening in an organism at once.
overlay.memoryTrick: Anabolism 'builds up' (think 'a-NA-bolism' sounds like adding). Catabolism 'breaks down' (think 'cata-strophe').
overlay.commonMisconception: Anabolic and catabolic pathways for the same molecule (like glucose synthesis vs breakdown) are usually not simply the reverse of each other — they typically use different enzymes and steps to allow independent regulation.
